In the first exchange ASEAN invited Britta Ramberg of MSB to present on behalf of the EU at the Global Platform for Disaster Risk Reduction 2022 GPDRR from 2327 May in Bali.For the second exchange the DG ECHO invited experts from LACER and AHA Centre to present on successful partnership principles at a panel during the European Union Civil Protection Forum in Brussels in June 2022.The third occasion to exchange experts saw the LACER Team Leader invited to participate in the ASEAN Strategic Policy Dialogue on Disaster Management SPDDM in Singapore 1819 August 2022 organised by the ASEAN Secretariat and the Singapore Civil Defence Force with the support of Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation.The fourth exchange concerned the launch of the Third Edition of ASEAN Risk Monitor and Disaster Management Review ARMOR in October 2022.

40 is an assumption value. In early 2023 LACERs Gender Advisor Olga Bezbozhna was invited to facilitate and colead an ASEAN Exchange Forum on the collection and use of disaggregated data in disaster response. The event scheduled for 2223 February in Vietnam built on earlier collaboration between LACER and ASEAN in integrating PGI into the regional response plan. The aim of the Exchange Forum was to bring ASEAN NDMOs together to share their experiences on disaggregation of data in emergencies with the ultimate aim of building a common standard to be used across the region. Participants included director level NDMO staff AHA assistant directors and directors members of the ACDM Working Group on Prevention and Mitigation and a representative of UNWOMEN. LACER played a key role in designing the agenda for the event surveying participants ensuring mainstreaming of SADD principles sex and age disaggregated data and creating a fully interactive implementation environment which encompassed multiple sharing sessions and many opportunities for member states and ASEAN regional bodies to describe their own practices.
